name: Playful
best_for: Warm creative stories and process explainers
avoid_for: Contexts where institutional credibility matters more than warmth — the peach palette is intentionally informal
weak_cases: Strong peach tonality can clash with supplied imagery; dense tables disrupt organic framing.
visual_signature: Double-outline offsets, small alternating rotations and constrained peach/ink scribbles.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: No handwriting face is required; retain outline/shape relationships while testing glyphs and wraps.

assets.images: Optional imagery must work with peach/ink surfaces and organic masks.
